name: Apex Material Technology Corp.
summary: Founded in 1998 and based in Keelung City, Taiwan, Apex Material Technology Corp., along with its affiliated companies, specializes in delivering touch technology solutions across Taiwan. The company manufactures and distributes both resistive and projected capacitive touch screens, as well as PenMount touch screen controllers. Beyond these core products, they offer an extensive range of services, including advanced touchscreen display and e-paper display solutions, open-frame touchscreen monitors, and optical bonding, supported by comprehensive touch solutions and dedicated post-purchase assistance. These offerings are widely utilized across various industries such as industrial, medical, public commercial, transportation, and outdoor environments.
